instruction: Please demonstrate to me how to play the video with a playback speed of 1.25x.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXTitle" of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "1147775047-1-208.mp4" && osascript -e 'tell application "QuickTime Player" to get rate of document 1' | grep -q "1.25" && echo "True" || echo "False"
